nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica B5 Cream

avis.texte: I really enjoyed the Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica b5 cream! It is a very lightweight gel formula that hydrates and moisturizes really well. There is little to scent which I prefer in a face cream. The tea tree ingredient calms my breakouts.
I've been suffering with dry skin especially around my mouth and cheeks ever since using this product I've no longer had any dryness. This is my new go to product and will continue using this daily.
The cream is nice because my face is always super dry in the winter and this cream is lightweight but hydrated me enough to only need one layer. Also the tea tree scent is nice and minty.

avis.titre: A new staple in my routine!
avis.texte: I love this product because it is not only so refreshing on the skin, it's so soothing in my problem/ red areas. I feel like it is so light and moisturizing with a wonderful clean tree tea scent. The scent can be a little strong at first but it does go away pretty quickly from what I noticed. I use it every morning just because I like to keep my skin feeling moisturized, especially before I put on my sun screen. Thank you to bzzagent for the opportunity to review this product that has now become a part of my routine. I would highly recommend to everyone and everyone.

I've been using this cream consistently for about 30 days, and overall I really like it — with a few climate-specific caveats. The texture is very lightweight and absorbs quickly, which makes it feel especially well-suited to warmer weather. In the SF Bay Area, I've found it performs much better during hot, dry summer days than it does in winter. Right now, during the colder months, my skin needs a bit more hydration than this provides on its own, so I tend to layer it or reach for something richer. That said, I love how calm and balanced my skin feels when I use it. It never feels greasy, heavy, or occlusive, and it wears beautifully under sunscreen and makeup. For anyone with combination or sensitive skin — especially in warm climates or during travel — this is a great option. I'll absolutely be saving this for spring and summer, and for upcoming warm-weather trips where I want something soothing, breathable, and easy to apply on the go. It may not be my deepest winter moisturizer, but it's earned a permanent spot in my seasonal rotation.

Really enjoy using this cream. The cream kept my skin hydrating since the weather started to get cold where I live. The cream didn't feel sticky when applying it to my face and it gave face a nice sheen. Works well when applying sunscreen on top of it. Definitely will continue to use this product since winter is around the corner.

Absolutely love this cream! It smells so fresh and clean! It's hydrates my face all night long! I even applied it under my makeup and it made my makeup look even better! It gives glass skin! Love love love!
I love how this cream feels on my skin! Lightweight, not greasy, and great under makeup. The scent is refreshing and calming for my face.

avis.titre: I would buy this product over and over again
avis.texte: I use this at the end of my skin care routine and it's amazing and has made a huge difference in morning routine.
Holy grail product. I suffer from rosacea flares up and this is heaven sent. Skin1004 has done it again. My face feels hydrated and it seems to calm the rosacea.
This B5 cream is so nice. It makes my skin look so glowy and nice.

I have been using this product for a couple weeks now. It comes out of the bottle like a cream but applies like a gel and absorbs quickly without stickiness. I appreciate the light scent, it's not overpowering but lets you know there is tea tree oil inside. I think this has done a good job of keeping my combination skin hydrating while keeping my oily spots under control. I receive this complimentary in exhange for an honest review.
This feels so good and nourishing on my sensitive, rosacea covered face. It doesn't cause any flare ups and feels so soothing. I have loved everything I have tried from skin1004.

This product is so great! I love this brand in general and have used a few of their items. This one in particular leaves my skin so hydrated. The weather is currently cold and dry and this moisturizes my skin and leaves all day hydration without feeling oily.

Disclaimer: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion. I enjoyed using this product and did not notice in adverse reactions to it. I didn't feel like it was moisturizing enough for my dry skin.

I received this moisturizer complimentary from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. I have oily skin, and finding a product that hydrates without leaving a heavy or greasy feeling can be a challenge — but this one really impressed me. The texture feels lightweight and refreshing, and it soaks into my skin almost instantly. Even with my oily skin, it never feels slick or shiny throughout the day. Instead, it gives me a balanced, hydrated feel that keeps my skin comfortable and smooth. Overall, it's been such a nice addition to my routine, and I'm genuinely happy with how well it works for my skin type.

avis.titre: I would buy this product over again!!
avis.texte: The tea tree cream has a watery texture which at first I was hesitant to try and after applying, I felt a hydration and face tightness.

Despite the very lightweight gel texture, this moisturizer leaves skin very hydrated. I even paired it over my tretinoin and it performed amazingly. The scent is a light tea tree scent and it even gives a slight cooling sensation which is so refreshing.

I love how lightweight this moisturizer felt on my skin. Really leaves your skin feeling soft and smooth. It's easy to apply, soaks in well without leaving a sticky residue. I also loved that it didn't make my skin breakout after use.

avis.titre: Amazing Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica B5 Cream!
avis.texte: I am genuinely impressed with this cream! The Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica B5 formula is super soothing and gentle on my skin. It calms redness almost instantly and gives my face a smooth, refreshed look without feeling heavy or greasy. The texture is lightweight but still moisturizing, and it absorbs really well. After using it consistently, my skin feels more balanced, less irritated, and overall healthier. It's perfect for sensitive or breakout-prone skin. If you're looking for something that hydrates, soothes, and strengthens your skin barrier all in one, this cream is a must-have. Definitely a 5-star product!
This is a great lightweight moisturizer that feels great on the skin despite the tea tree oil.

I like the consistency of the product and the gel formula. However the tea tree feels like it can potentially not be suitable for sensitive skin. It worked well on my skin but I will need a few more weeks to know for certain.

avis.titre: Great for my dry winter skin
avis.texte: Love the packaging and the product! Felt lightweight and had a cooling aspect to it while providing instant moisture! I really struggle in the winter with dry skin especially on my face and this helped overnight, would recommend 100%!

I'm quite impressed after this product was gifted to me by BzzAgent, it arrived at a perfect time as I've had tremendous stress lately and found myself battling a persistent bout of acne. This product worked well over the course of nearly a week to reduce redness and irritation, as well as the pimples themselves, without over drying my skin!

I've been really enjoying this cream! It feels lightweight but still gives. great hydration. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a sticky finish. My skin looks more balanced and feels smoother after using it consistently. Definitely a product I'm happy to keep in my routine!

This absorbed into my skin really well. It is lightweight like a gel cream, and I didn't notice a matte finish. It is more soft and smooth, not dewy or glowy at all. Great for night and day and makeup goes on really well. If you are needing a lot of moisture, it might not be enough.

This cream is a soothing moisturizer that feels instantly calming on the skin. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly which makes it great for both morning and night routines. The ingredient list is the real highlight. Centella asiatica, tea tree extract and vitamin B5 work together to calm irritation and support a healthier barrier. These ingredients are known for reducing redness and helping stressed skin recover. With consistent use my skin feels more balanced and hydrated. It is a great choice for anyone dealing with sensitivity or occasional breakouts who wants gentle but effective soothing care.

avis.titre: Hydration falls short because of the tea tree oil
avis.texte: I get what this product is trying to do. It feels like a 2-in-1 that mixes tea tree oil for blemishes with a thick hydrating moisturizer. I don't mind tea tree oil on its own, but having it blended into a moisturizer this rich throws me off. My skin is combo, drier in the winter and oily in the summer, so I'm fine using tea tree oil when my skin can handle it (summer time), but when it's winter time, and I want to dry out pimples, I stick to using either tret or benzoyl peroxide (which both don't have scents). I just don't always want it in my daily moisturizer, esp. one with a weird artificial smelling tea tree oil. IDK something is off about the tea tree oil in this moisturizer... which is weird because I do love the scent of tea tree oil, esp. ones sourced from Australia. Also, IMO, the hydration was also lighter than I expected given the other ingredients. I'm guessing the tea tree oil and the mattifying angle work against the moisture level a bit. It's not bad if you want something that targets the occasional pimple, but as a straight hydrating moisturizer, it didn't quite deliver for me as someone in her 30s and has combo (leaning drier) skin in the winter time. Would recommend this for those who are younger and/or have combo skin that's more oily or dry, acne prone skin.
This is a nice moisturizer. It has tea tree, and it's a lightweight.
Love it amazing light refreshing scent that keeps my face moisturised all day

I received this Tea-Trica B5 Cream as a complimentary gift from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. I have very sensitive skin with rosacea and get painful flare-ups, and this moisturizer felt nice on my skin! It was very cooling, and has a gel-cream hybrid consistency. It is thicker than a gel and hydrates well. The only thing I don't love is the scent, it's a little too earthy and fragrant for me!
I received this moisturizer to review and it is a really great product. It is lightweight and super moisturizing. Wears great with makeup and felt great on the skin. Would recommend
This is a lightweight moisturizer and it feels clean and comfortable on my skin. It helps with irritation and my dry skin. I would absolutely recommend it

avis.titre: Beautiful consistency and leaves my face glowing!!
avis.texte: This face cream smells lightly minty, feels fresh and it's hydrating but not that much, so I add a little of my cicaplast baum on specific spots that need extra hydration at night and add my SPF in the day. I do feel it improves the skin texture. Would recommend for mixed to normal skin.

I received this Tea-Trica B5 Cream as a complimentary gift from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. I've been using a few products from the Madagascar Centella line and I've always enjoyed them — this cream is no exception! The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or sticky. It gives a nice boost of hydration and leaves my skin feeling soft and soothed. I have normal skin, and this cream works perfectly both in my morning and evening routine. It also layers well under makeup and doesn't clog pores. Overall, a very refreshing and calming cream that I would definitely recommend, especially if you're looking for gentle hydration and barrier support.
great moisturizer, left my skin feeling soft and supple for the entire night + day. texture is slightly thick but it absorbs well. slightly oily.

Good ingredients. It has a smell, but I know it is part of the natural scene of the ingredients. I will use this when my skin is feeling oily and probably avoid it when dry, but it seems to work pretty well for breakouts.

avis.titre: My skin has never felt softer
avis.texte: I do not normally go out of my way to leave reviews but I was so impressed with this cream that I felt compelled. I am absolutely obsessed with it. The Madagascar Cantella Tea-Trica B5 Cream has completely transformed my skin. It's lightweight, soothing, and absorbs beautifully without feeling greasy. Within days, I noticed my redness calming down, breakouts healing faster, and my skin looking more balanced overall. I also love how gentle it is which is perfect for my sensitive and stressed skin. It gives that hydrated, healthy glow without clogging my pores. I can already tell this is going to be a permanent part of my skincare routine.
Very light weight, none greasy, hydrating without feeling oily My face feels like baby skin very soothing for acne prone skin I definitely recommend this cream.
I apply this as the final step morning and night. It feels really lightweight on the skin and doesn't leave a residue.

avis.titre: This is such an amazing product!
avis.texte: This product feels amazing on my skin, it's smooth, silky but doesn't leave you feeling wet
It works well as the last step to your routine as an occulsive. Its a bit exfoliating but thats great for acne prone skin. I would recommend.
This is a really nice product! Great for breakouts or troubled skin! Didn't irritate my sensitive skin which i appreciate!!
